replacements.reason: Command_03 stores its 26-bit loop count in the same 32-bit event_return word array used for command pointers. Exact GALE01 assembly masks the command word to 26 bits and stores that raw word; the explicit uintptr_t bridge preserves the same native i686 value and representation without treating it as a dereferenceable pointer.

GALE01 Command_04 decrements the top 32-bit loop counter and copies the preceding 32-bit return address into CommandInfo.u. The decomp's ptr[1] array hack performs out-of-bounds typed pointer indexing and fails to update u under native GCC, making every loop finish in one frame. Explicit indices and uintptr_t conversions preserve the original i686 word layout, nested-loop stack order, signed zero test, and command ordering without undefined array or aliasing behavior.
